instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES: yarn add lucide-react @radix-ui/react-icons recharts framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge date-fns react-day-picker
SETUP_THEME: Update tailwind.config.js to use the Orange primary color palette defined in colors section.
LAYOUT: Create two distinct layouts - 'AdminLayout' (Sidebar) and 'POSLayout' (Full screen, hidden nav).
POS_UI: Ensure all clickable elements in POS view have min-h-[48px] for touch accessibility.
NAVIGATION: POS navigation should be category based tabs or a side rail.
MOCK_DATA: Populate the Menu Grid with the provided food images and prices.
CHARTS: Use Recharts for the Admin Dashboard (Revenue, Orders per day).
DARK_MODE: Implement a 'Night Shift' toggle for low-light restaurant environments (Dark grey background, Orange accents).
universal_guidelines: Do NOT use default 'blue' for primary actions. Use Orange-500.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Manrope'.
Always add hover effects: brightness-95 or translate-y-[-2px].
Ensure high contrast for text on orange backgrounds (use white text on orange-500).
